text_block_list.text: We're here, Trainer! We're really here!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime test of fate! An epic
race!
Winner takes all!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I gotta go in with everything I've got!
After all, I'm
taking on Grass and Suzuka
here!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The crowd is totally packed. The fans
are so
enthusiastic, you wouldn't believe
it was a G2.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let me hear it, Trainer! Who's the
number one
Umamusume?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna blow Suzuka out of the
water and
advance to the Japan Cup?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Bueno! I'm off to the paddock!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's have a good race today, Suzuka! I...
I'm...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming high enough to see the whole
world! So
whatever it is you're aiming
for, I plan to go
higher!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I see... Well, let's do our best. But...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm not really aiming for anything. I just
want to
see a view with no one else in
sight...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
El, she's our competitor. We are looking
at things
from a different perspective.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Despite each racer having different
goals, the
course and distance that lay
before them remains
the same. Only one
can claim victory!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
